The '''Belsavis Prison Administration Center''' was the main headquarters for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Warden [[Playt]]'s offices were located there, and the only official [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] off of Belsavis departed from the Administration Center.
